mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, display_title, icon_key, latest_version, listed, revision, created_at, updated_at
uuid, external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, state, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM builtin_skills WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skills (uuid, external_id, display_title, icon_key, listed) VALUES (#{skill.UUID}, #{skill.ExternalID}, #{skill.DisplayTitle}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{skill.IconKey}, ''), 'blocks'), false) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skills SET icon_key = #{skill.IconKey}, latest_version = #{skill.LatestVersion}, listed = #{skill.Listed}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{skill.UUID} AND revision = #{skill.Revision} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skill_versions (uuid, external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, state, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at) VALUES (#{version.UUID}, #{version.ExternalID}, #{version.SkillUUID}, #{version.SkillExternalID}, #{version.Version}, #{version.Name}, #{version.Description}, #{version.Directory}, 'draft', #{version.S3Bucket}, #{version.S3Key}, #{version.SizeBytes}, #{version.SHA256}, #{version.CreatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skill_versions SET state = 'published' WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'draft' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, skill_uuid, actor_uuid, action, version, created_at FROM system_skill_events WHERE skill_uuid = #{skillUUID} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_skill_events (skill_uuid, actor_uuid, action, version) VALUES (#{event.SkillUUID}, #{event.ActorUUID}, #{event.Action}, #{event.Version})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE s3_key = #{key})
